name: applies-to-merge-targets-not-deduplicated
body: `applies_to_missing_languages` lists the applies-to targets the merged record set does not already label, without deduplicating: several records sharing one target in a single delta issue a redundant no-op `MERGE (n:Language {fqn})` and re-insert the same `known` key. Limit: materialisation statement count scales with record count, not with distinct languages. Upgrade: dedupe the missing-target list before materialising if one batch can carry many applies-to records naming the same language.
